title: United States Lines Of Business (v2.9)
text:
United States Lines Of Business (v2.9)
 

LOB codes for U.S., Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

Note:

CATRADER
 uses Standard LOB assignments for Sums Insured, Risks, and Premiums. Refer to the Standard Lines of Business table below.

Touchstone Re
 uses Market Share LOB assignments for Market Shares and also for Sums Insured, Risks, and Premiums. Refer to the Market Shares Lines of Business table below.
